ValidationRule.description: This rule will prohibit a Sales Rep/Manager from changing an opportunity stage to Declined.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR( $User.Title = "Business Finance Consultant", $User.Title = "Sr. Account Manager", $User.Title = "Relationship Manager", $User.Title = "Sales Manager", $User.Title = "Working Capital Sales Manager", $User.Title = "Account Executive"), ISCHANGED(StageName), ISPICKVAL((StageName), "Declined"))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Sales cannot change the Stage of an Opportunity to Declined. Please select offers not accepted or Desktop Decline if the deal is no longer live.
